english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone employed to manage and oversee a household.

examples.english: They are our housekeeper, responsible for managing the domestic staff and daily household chores.
examples.traditional: 佢係我哋屋企嘅管家，負責安排工人同打理日常家務。
